feeds.title: Patient Safety in Surgery
feeds.description: Patient Safety in Surgery is an open access journal that publishes articles on all issues related to safety and quality of patient care in surgery and surgical subspecialties. The journal provides a scientific platform for specialists from all surgical fields and for other healthcare professionals to report, discuss, debate, and critically review all aspects related to errors, complications, and other safety issues in the management of patients undergoing surgical procedures.

feeds.title: Anesthesia Patient Safety Foundation
feeds.description: The Anesthesia Patient Safety Foundation is the pioneer organization dedicated to assuring patient safety in anesthesia care. Their mission is to improve the safety of patients during anesthesia care by: Identifying safety initiatives and creating recommendations to implement directly and with partner organizations, Being a leading voice for anesthesia patient safety worldwide, Supporting and advancing anesthesia patient safety culture, knowledge, and learning.Our vision is 'That no one shall be harmed by anesthesia care.'

feeds.title: PSQH
feeds.description: Patient Safety & Quality Healthcare magazine provides clinicians, healthcare professionals, and consumers with news, case studies, and research reported by experts in safety and quality improvement while keeping facilities and patients safe.

feeds.title: ConnectID Blog » Patient Safety
feeds.description: PDC Healthcare is a trusted leader in identification and patient safety solutions, with products in use at over 90% of US hospitals. ConnectID by PDC Healthcare provides the latest news and solutions for identification in both acute and non-acute healthcare settings directly from the experts at PDC Healthcare. See how positive identification solutions improve patient safety.

feeds.title: The Patient Safety Company Blog
feeds.description: The Patient Safety Company (TPSC) is an international supplier and producer of innovative Quality & Risk Management solutions for the healthcare industry. They offer a flexible solution to register and analyze incidents, automate follow-up processes, and to manage your improvement plans. This blog keeps you up-to-date about the latest insights related to Patient Safety and Quality- en Risk management in Healthcare.

feeds.title: Surescripts » Intelligence in Action
feeds.description: Surescripts has led the movement to turn health data into actionable intelligence to increase patient safety, lower costs, and ensure quality care. Our purpose is to serve the nation with the single most trusted and capable health information network, built to increase patient safety, lower costs, and ensure quality care. We believe better decisions mean increased safety, lower cost, and higher quality and in protecting patient and provider choice.

feeds.title: Center for Patient Safety
feeds.description: The Center for Patient Safety is an independent, not-for-profit organization dedicated to reducing preventable harm. At CPS, our focus is on learning what medical errors occur, why they occur, and how to prevent patient harm. Stay current with PSO and patient safety information.

feeds.title: BeMedwise
feeds.description: BeMedWise Program at NeedyMeds encourages healthcare professionals and community groups to foster patient-professional communication about medicines. Their mission is to promote the safe use, storage, and disposal of medicines for better health. And vision is improved health outcomes through responsible medication practices.Signup to BeMedwise and be the first to get notified on new updates.

feeds.title: CAPS
feeds.description: Consumer Advancing Patient Safety (CAPS) envisions a partnership between consumers and providers to create global healthcare systems that are safe, compassionate, and just. CAPS champion patient safety led by consumers in partnership and collaboration with providers. Our vision is safe and equitable health care for every woman.

feeds.title: Kaiser Health News » Patient Safety
feeds.description: Kaiser Health News (KHN) is a nonprofit news service committed to in-depth coverage of health care policy and politics. They report on how the health care system like hospitals, doctors, nurses, insurers, governments, consumers works. Get the latest news on Patient Safety from Kaiser Health News.
